editorial.blurb: A beloved neighborhood gem in Hyde Park that feels like home the moment you walk in, serving generous portions of comforting diner classics and Greek-inspired dishes with genuine warmth.
editorial.insiderTip: Come early for breakfast to experience their fluffy omelets and crisp-outside, soft-inside waffles paired with fresh-squeezed orange juice—the kitchen moves quickly even when busy, and portions are remarkably generous for the price.
